recentItems.title: Stereophonics - Seems Like You Don’t Know Me
recentItems.description:
‘Seems Like You Don’t Know Me’ OUT NOW!
Listen here: https://stereophonics.lnk.to/SLYDKMID
 
Pre-order ‘Make ‘em Laugh, Make ‘em Cry, Make ‘em Wait’, out on the 25th April 2025 here: https://stereophonics.lnk.to/MELMECMEWID
 
Get the latest news: https://Stereophonics.lnk.to/EmailListID
 
Join Stereophonics online:
Website: https://www.stereophonics.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/stereophonics/
Twitter: https://www.twitter.com/stereophonics
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/stereophonicsofficial/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@stereophonicsofficial
 
Lyrics:
Hey there princess, let down your hair
Top of the tower, way up there
You got your rings and you bangles of gold
You got your fairy tale the way it got told
 
So how ya’ doing, how ya’ doing?
When’s enough, enough for you?
 
So your lie, is really my truth
And you knew that, when I met you
So how ya’ doing? How ya’ doing?
When’s enough, enough for you?
‘Cause my heart’s been busted in two
 
Seems like you don’t know me
And I don’t know you at all
So how ya’ doing? Road to ruin
House of cards about to fall
 
Seems like you don’t know me
And I don’t know you at all
So how ya’ doing? Road to ruin
Now my back’s against the wall
 
#Stereophonics #SeemsLikeYouDontKnowMe #MakeEmLaughMakeEmCryMakeEmWait
